messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for hotlet-01 (GPU hot pool). Capacity hit 98%, best-effort pods evicted. Autoscaler routed low-priority traffic to cpu-fallback in us-west. Opening this thread for live coordination.
maria: I'm oncall, picking this up. Quick TL;DR pls — customer impact?
cheng: seeing short 429 spikes and queued requests. KV cache pressure on the 512-token workloads. Majority of traffic is embeddings jobs from a single tenant.
alex: can we shift any reserved nodes from steady pools to hotlet-01? How long to reprovision?
maria: running runbook step now: `evacuate_hotlet --pool hotlet-01` starting capacity transfer. Notifying infra.
sam: infra estimate: 20 GPUs we can move, but warmup ~12 minutes (driver + container pull). Starting prep now. ETA ~12m.
ops-bot: Runbook checklist updated: [x] pager acknowledged [ ] capacity shift in progress [ ] customer notif sent [ ] postmortem scheduled
maria: notified top-3 affected customers via status.redwood.ai and posted to support queue. No confirmed SLA breaches yet but elevated error rates for embeddings.
cheng: created INF-8921 (Remediation: hot-pool fragmentation & autoscaler policy). Assigned to eng-runtime and eng-sre. Notes: need thermal-safe packing + pre-warm strategy for CPU fallback.
alex: proposing two immediate action items: 1) increase autoscaler headroom from 10% -> 20% during predicted peak windows; 2) implement pre-warm for cpu-fallback instances for high-likelihood traffic bursts. Thoughts?
sam: +1 on pre-warm. We'll add cost guardrails (max pre-warm minutes, tagged metrics). Will prototype in staging.
maria: planning a 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC. I'll own the writeup and timeline. Please add any relevant logs or traces to the JIRA.
acheng: leaving detailed notes: observed pattern — single-tenant burst (embeddings) with poor batching characteristics. Short-term mitigation: tenant-level rate limiter + improve backpressure at router.
alex: I'll add the runbook checklist for this specific failure mode and add tests to the chaos suite.
maria: marking incident as monitored. If infra confirms capacity moved and error rates fall, we'll resolve.
ops-bot: Incident resolved at 2350123620 — traffic stabilized after capacity shift and cpu-fallback warmup. Closing pager but keeping INF-8921 open for remediation tracking. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all — action owners: sam (infra capacity playbook), cheng (fallback warmup + router backpressure), alex (runbook + chaos test), maria (postmortem writeup). Ping me if you need changes to assignments. :thumbsup:
